Rashi on Berakhot 10b:10:1.hebrew: ביום שלשים של אדר - ואע"פ שלא נתקדש החדש, שעדיין לא באו עדים:
Rashi on Berakhot 10b:10:1.english: On the thirtieth day of Adar - And even though the [new] month has not been sanctified, as witnesses have not yet arrived.

Rashi on Berakhot 10b:11:1.hebrew: התולה בזכות עצמו - שאומר בתפלתו: עשה לי בזכותי, כגון חזקיהו שאמר: זכר נא את אשר התהלכתי לפניך וגו':
Rashi on Berakhot 10b:11:1.english: One who relies on his own merit - That he says in his prayer: "Act for me in my merit," such as Hezekiah, who said: "Remember now that I walked before You..." etc.

Rashi on Berakhot 10b:15:1.english: Uncovered - Open, whose roof had been removed.

Rashi on Berakhot 10b:21:1.english: One who wishes to benefit - From that which belongs to others.

Rashi on Berakhot 10b:21:2.english: He may benefit - And there is no prohibition in the matter.

Rashi on Berakhot 10b:21:3.english: Like Elisha - As we find with Elisha, that he benefited.

Rashi on Berakhot 10b:21:4.english: And one who does not wish to benefit - From that which belongs to others.

Rashi on Berakhot 10b:21:5.hebrew: אל יהנה - ואין בדבר לא משום גסות רוח ולא משום שנאה:
Rashi on Berakhot 10b:21:5.english: He should not benefit - And there is in the matter neither arrogance nor hatred.

Rashi on Berakhot 10b:21:6.hebrew: כשמואל הרמתי - כמו שמצינו בשמואל הרמתי, שלא רצה להנות:
Rashi on Berakhot 10b:21:6.english: Like Samuel the Ramathite - As we find regarding Samuel the Ramathite, who did not want to benefit [from others].

Rashi on Berakhot 10b:21:7.hebrew: כי שם ביתו - לעיל מיניה כתיב: והיה מדי שנה בשנה וסבב בית אל והמצפה ושפט את ישראל, וסמיך ליה: ותשובתו הרמתה כי שם ביתו. וכי איני יודע ששם ביתו? אלא אכולהו מקומות דקרא דלעיל מיניה קאי, שכל מקום שהיה הולך שם, היה נושא כל כלי תשמישי בית עמו ואהל חנייתו, שלא להנות מן אחרים:
Rashi on Berakhot 10b:21:7.english: For there was his house - Prior to this, it is written: "And he would go from year to year and circuit Bethel and Mizpah, and judge Israel," and adjacent to it: "And his return was to Ramah, for there was his house." And do I not know that his house was there? Rather, it refers to all the places [mentioned] in the verse prior to it: that wherever he went, he would carry all his household utensils with him and his encampment tent, so as not to benefit from others.

Rashi on Berakhot 10b:24:1.english: By the majesty of her beauty - By her breasts.

Rashi on Berakhot 10b:27:1.english: A prayer of the poor - In the manner of poverty.

Rashi on Berakhot 10b:28:1.english: He should align his feet - One next to the other.

Rashi on Berakhot 10b:28:2.english: And their feet were a straight foot - They appear as one foot.

Rashi on Berakhot 10b:37:1.english: He shall recline - On his side.

Rashi on Berakhot 10b:37:2.english: He shall stand - As it is written: "And when you rise."

Rashi on Berakhot 10b:37:3.english: When you lie down - In the manner of lying down.

Rashi on Berakhot 10b:38:1.hebrew: כדרכו - או בקימה, או בשכיבה, או בישיבה, או מהלך:
Rashi on Berakhot 10b:38:1.english: In his [own] way - Either standing, or lying down, or sitting, or walking.

Rashi on Berakhot 10b:4:1.english: My father's father who covered the Sanctuary - [This was] Solomon.

Rashi on Berakhot 10b:5:1.hebrew: שגנז ספר רפואות - כדי שיבקשו רחמים:
Rashi on Berakhot 10b:5:1.english: That he suppressed the Book of Remedies - So that they would pray for mercy.

Rashi on Berakhot 10b:7:1.hebrew: גירר עצמות אביו - לפי שהיה רשע, בזהו ולא נהג בו כבוד בקבורתו, להוציאו כהוגן במטות זהב וכסף:
Rashi on Berakhot 10b:7:1.english: He dragged the bones of his father - Because he was wicked, he disgraced him and did not accord him honor at his burial, [such as] to carry him out properly on biers of gold and silver.

Rashi on Berakhot 10b:8:1.hebrew: סתם מי גיחון - מי שלוח, בדברי הימים (ב לב). ולמה? כדי שלא יבאו מלכי אשור וימצאו מים לשתות. ולא זהו גיחון הנהר הגדול, דההוא לאו בא"י הוא, אלא מעין קטן הוא סמוך לירושלים, שנאמר: והורדתם אותו אל גיחון (מלכים א א׳:ל״ג), ומתרגמינן: ותחתון יתיה לשילוחא:
Rashi on Berakhot 10b:8:1.english: He stopped up the waters of Gihon - [These are] the waters of Shiloah, [as recorded] in Chronicles (II 32). And why? In order that the kings of Assyria would not come and find water to drink. And this is not Gihon, the great river, for that one is not in the Land of Israel; rather, it is a small spring near Jerusalem, as it is stated: "And bring him down to Gihon" (I Kings 1:33), and we translate: "And bring him down to Shiloah."

Rashi on Berakhot 10b:8:2.hebrew: עבר ניסן בניסן - קס"ד: משנתקדש החדש לשם ניסן, נמלך לעבר את השנה ועשאו אדר, כמו שנאמר בדברי הימים (ב ל): ויועץ המלך (חזקיהו) לעשות הפסח בחדש השני:
Rashi on Berakhot 10b:8:2.english: He intercalated Nisan in Nisan - [The Gemara] initially thought: Once the month had been sanctified as Nisan, he reconsidered to intercalate the year and made it Adar, as it is stated in Chronicles (II 30): "And the king [Hezekiah] took counsel to observe Passover in the second month."

Tosafot on Berakhot 10b:36:1.hebrew: גדול הקורא ק"ש בעונתה יותר מהעוסק בתורה - תימה: אפ' תפלה נמי! דהא אמרינן פ"ק דשבת ( ד' יא.): כגון אנן מפסיקין בין לק"ש בין לתפלה. וי"ל, דהכי קאמר: יותר מהעוסק בתורה פעם אחרת, שלא בשעת ק"ש. אבל העוסק בתורה בשעת ק"ש — לא מיירי, ואפ' בתפלה פוסק:
Tosafot on Berakhot 10b:36:1.english: "Greater is one who recites the Shema in its proper time than one who is engaged in Torah study" - [This is] astonishing: Even [for] prayer as well [one interrupts]! For behold, we say in the first chapter of Shabbat (11a): "The likes of us interrupt both for Shema and for prayer." And one can say that this is what [the Gemara] means: [It is] greater than one who engages in Torah study at another time, not during the time of Shema. But regarding one who is engaged in Torah study during the time of Shema, [the Gemara] does not deal [with that case], as even for prayer one interrupts [one's study].
